We never had no problems 'cept for Yankees.|Catherine after being captured by the [[Van der Linde gang]].}} '''Catherine Braithwaite''' is a major antagonist in the 2018 action-adventure video game ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Red_Dead_Redemption_2 Red Dead Redemption II].'' She is the head and matriarch of the [[Braithwaite Family]], who are rivals of the [[Gray Family]] in the Scarlett Meadows region of Lemoyne and associate of Italian crime boss [[Angelo Bronte]]. Just like the rest of her family and ancestors, she holds a strong grudge and dislike towards the Grays. She was portrayed by Ellen Harvey, who lent the voice and motion capture for her. ==Biography== === Background === Little is known about Catherine’s past. It is known that she is from English descent and had four children with an unknown man : Bartholomew, Gareth, Gerald and Gertrude. However, as Gertrude was disfigured and mentally unwell, she was locked in an outhouse on the Braithwaite Manor land rather than being sent to a sanitarium, in fear of the family name being tarnished if word of Gertrude’s health ever got out. The abolition of slavery in 1865, following the defeat of the South in the Civil War, significantly damaged the Braithwaites, who lost a huge amount of money, as well as the Grays. Prior to 1899, Catherine began selling moonshine to the [[Lemoyne Raiders]] through an illegitimate side business, acquainted [[Angelo Bronte]] and had a passion for Thoroughbred horses. === ''Events of Red Dead Redemption II'' === In 1899, the [[Van der Linde gang]] had stolen a shipment of liquor from the Braithwaite family, on behalf of the Grays. Leading members [[Hosea Matthews]] and [[Arthur Morgan]] sell the liquor back to the Braithwaites, who offer them and their leader [[Dutch van der Linde]] work. She tells them to sell the moonshine at the saloon in Rhodes to advertise their product, where they are eventually ambushed by [[Lemoyne Raiders]] who were hoping to buy the moonshine from Catherine herself. On the suggestion of [[Tavish Gray]], Arthur, [[John Marston]] and [[Javier Escuella]] stole Catherine’s prized horses to sell them for good price, although Tavish scammed them on the real price, angering the three men. Before or after this mission (the player can choose to start one or the other), Catherine has Arthur and [[Sean MacGuire]] sneak onto Caliga Hall to burn down the Gray’s tobacco fields in order to permanently put them out of business. Eventually, after realizing she had been fooled, she ends up double-crossing the Van der Linde gang and kidnaps John and [[Abigail Roberts]]’ four year old son [[Jack Marston|Jack]] before selling him to Angelo Bronte in Saint Denis. This proves to the nail in the Braithwaites’ coffin, as in retaliation, Dutch and numerous gang members leaves immediately to ambush the mansion and get the boy back. The Van der Linde gang successfully dispatches Catherine's henchmen and raids her mansion. After her two last sons and guards are shot, Catherine is found hiding in a room and refuses to reveal Jack’s whereabouts, continuing to insult them. Dutch decides to take her outside and finish one of her sons who was still barely alive to fuel her agony and drags her in the stairs by the hair and outside the mansion as the gang sets it on fire. Outside, as the mansion starts to burn, Catherine claims that there isn’t rules in war, before finally revealing she gave Jack to Bronte. The gang then leaves the scene and Catherine runs back into her mansion in distress and dies in an act of self-immolation. == Relationships == === Allies === * [[Lemoyne Raiders]] * [[Angelo Bronte]] * Saint Denis Mob * Business owners === Enemies === * [[Van der Linde gang]] * [[Gray Family]] * Politicians * Yankees ==Personality== Being a wealthy deep southern woman in the late 1800's, Catherine Braithewaite is an egotistical and proud person, believing herself to be superior to most others and especially those she considers "Yankees" since her home was a former confederate slave plantation. Catherine was so petty that she kidnapped Jack, an innocent young kid, as the gang stole their liquor. This proves that she has no problem going beyond what is good to get back at people, and will betray anyone for profit. But one thing she has going for her, is her undying love to her sons as she cries and yells after they are killed, even committing suicide to honour them. ==Gallery== File:Braithwaite Family.png|Catherine and her sons confronting Arthur and Hosea.
